full_inspection: All four complete native images of copy1site058 and copy2site134 were inspected. Every prose line, index, displayed map, underline, all nine diagram arrows and their node labels, NB line, foliation and margins were compared. audit_134_details.jpg preserves the paired punctuation, inline-arrow length, shared subscript traces, lowered copy2 point and copy1-only lower-right trace. All six handwritten diagonal edges are individually recorded. Apart from the twelve recorded loci, the source readings agree.
original_transcription_comparison: Both supplied original transcriptions were compared in full. They differed in the second topologie point, second inline-arrow length, archive foliation and scan metadata. Both omitted the six handwritten diagram-edge classifications and shared colon-like subscript traces. Copy2 additionally omitted the point below the p of plongement. These visual findings are recorded individually; the later ampersand repairs are exact syntax-only replay transitions.
